title: Setting Up Verifone As Your Payment Gateway
text:
## Setting Up Verifone As Your Payment Gateway
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000010258
For the best results Stripe is the recommended payment gateway .
However, for those who would like to setup 2checkout as their payment gateway, follow the steps below after entering payment gateway credentials .

## Setup The Instant Notification Settings
After logging in to the account, click on the 'Instant Notification' Setting icon on the top navigation:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12009083297/original/blob1472668766587.png?1472668766 | alt: ]
In the Global Settings field, enter the following URL, replacing " www.domain.com " with the domain of the website:
http:// www.domain.com /checkout/notifications/2checkout
For example, if the domain of the website is www.marys-website.com then the following URL must be entered into this field:
http:// www.marys-website.com /checkout/notifications/2checkout
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005754973/original/blob1464723533146.png?1464723529 | alt: ]
Click on  "Apply"  and  "Save Settings" button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005754941/original/blob1464723501964.png?1464723498 | alt: ]

## Setup The Checkout Options
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12009083334/original/blob1472668839706.png?1472668840 | alt: ]
Fill out all of the options on this page with the information relevant to the website.
In the "Direct Return" section of the options, select "Header Redirect":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12005761090/original/blob1464736750676.png?1464736747 | alt: ]
Click on the "Save Changes" button in the bottom-right portion of the screen to save these settings.
After completing this, the 2Checkout account should be all setup to accept payments through Brilliant Directories websites.
